stem: A 15-year-old who appears mature and competent discloses consensual sex with a similar-aged partner and denies coercion or safety concerns. What is the most appropriate approach?

options.text: Automatically notify police in every case
Tell the parents immediately without discussion
Provide confidential assessment, contraception and STI care while assessing capacity and safeguarding concerns
Refuse care unless a parent is present
Ignore the disclosure because it is not medical

explanation: Adolescent sexual health care should be confidential where appropriate, with assessment of maturity, consent, coercion, exploitation and safety. Mandatory reporting depends on jurisdiction and risk, not the mere fact of every consensual similar-age relationship.
